description: This is a shell script used in the build process of TensorFlow to generate tarballs and jars for distribution. It includes functions for building tarballs, copying and normalizing source jar files, and contains commands for invoking bazel build and test targets specific to TensorFlow's build system.

methods.name: build_libtensorflow_tarball
methods.description: Builds and packages TensorFlow library tarballs, including testing and copying build artifacts.

methods.name: cp_normalized_srcjar
methods.description: Copies and normalizes source jar files to conform to a Maven-like directory layout.
